basis: Registered clean PSD shows lowest-frequency power at about 80-125 Hz, substantial sentence-dependent 4-8 kHz power, and noise across the speech band. Broad coarse sensitivity grid; no loss threshold selected. Include HP/LP/bypass controls. Refine 20-150 Hz HPF cutoffs in 2 Hz steps and wide BPF 60-120 Hz / 6-7.99 kHz; evaluate every integer prototype order 1-16. High-band protection prevents total-energy-only optimization from discarding weak speech components. Final local refinement in 1 Hz lower-cutoff steps around the observed knee; upper-cutoff sensitivity around 7.75-7.99 kHz. This resolution does not imply equivalent experimental certainty (PSD bin width 7.8125 Hz).

selection_rule.benefit: equal-condition mean noise power reduction dB over 144 registered-interval cases
selection_rule.loss: maximum of worst-recording percentage losses in total Clean, 2-4 kHz Clean, and 4-8 kHz Clean
selection_rule.score: benefit divided by maximum observed benefit minus loss divided by loss at that benefit endpoint
selection_rule.reference: bypass origin; same coarse endpoint retained in refined scan
selection_rule.scope: common across all three noises and four SNRs; exact single-pass response; two highest-scoring Pareto settings
